id./param/scenario/cs/y_010_cs_040.pack|cs_:
{var:1} told the Tockle Elder
what happened in the Adventure Log's world.

"What! Garai Town in the Log's world
  was attacked by monsters!?

"Hmm... This is only my guess, but the Log's
  being defiled has likely rewritten
  the history of the world inside.

"To restore the rewritten history, perhaps
  we need only listen to the troubled folk of
  the Logs' worlds and solve their problems.

"When all the Adventure Logs' histories
  are restored, our mission will be fulfilled.

"But for that we need many Logs' pastwords
  and Tockles to find them.

"...So I had Kurutchi and the others prepare
  something for the Hero.
  Please follow me.

"We Tockles joined forces to make this
  guild for the Hero, tchi!
  It's the {var:1} Guild, tchi!

"Ha ha, were you surprised?
  This {var:1} Guild is what I had
  Kurutchi prepare.

"The guild's marvel is that Tockles you pass
  via StreetPass will come to it... that is!

"From now on, you can use StreetPass to
  gather Tockle warriors to send into
  the Labyrinth of Time!

"Talk to the Tockles around Erdrea or use
  StreetPass, and gather as many
  Tockles as you can.

"To learn more about StreetPass or
  change settings, tell me, tchi!

"Send Tockles into the Labyrinth to gather
  pastwords, and someday every Adventure
  Log can be restored.

"The Tockles' mission of passing on heroes'
  feats depends on your deeds!
  I'm counting on you, Hero!
